claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

namespace GeneratedExcision

universe u v w z

structure BiTransfer {A : Type u} {B : Type v}
    [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] (f : A →+ B) (q : ℕ) where
  backward : B →+ A
  forward_backward : ∀ y, f (backward y) = q • y
  backward_forward : ∀ x, backward (f x) = q • x

variable {A₀ : Type u} {B₀ : Type v} {A₁ : Type w} {B₁ : Type z}
  [AddCommGroup A₀] [AddCommGroup B₀] [AddCommGroup A₁] [AddCommGroup B₁]

def doubleTransfer
    (f : A₀ →+ B₀) (g : A₁ →+ B₁)
    (iA : A₀ →+ A₁) (iB : B₀ →+ B₁)
    (dA : A₁ →+ A₀) (dB : B₁ →+ B₀)
    (square : ∀ x, g (iA x) = iB (f x))
    (natural : ∀ x, dB (g x) = f (dA x))
    (doubleA : ∀ x, iA (dA x) = 2 • x)
    (doubleB : ∀ y, iB (dB y) = 2 • y)
    (q : ℕ) (t : BiTransfer f q) : BiTransfer g (2 * q) where
  backward := iA.comp (t.backward.comp dB)
  forward_backward := by
    intro y
    change g (iA (t.backward (dB y))) = (2 * q) • y
    rw [square, t.forward_backward, map_nsmul, doubleB]
    simp [smul_smul, Nat.mul_comm]
  backward_forward := by
    intro x
    change iA (t.backward (dB (g x))) = (2 * q) • x
    rw [natural, t.backward_forward, map_nsmul, doubleA]
    simp [smul_smul, Nat.mul_comm]

theorem transfer_bounds {A : Type u} {B : Type v}
    [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B]
    {f : A →+ B} {q : ℕ} (t : BiTransfer f q) :
    (∀ x, f x = 0 → q • x = 0) ∧
      (∀ y, ∃ x, f x = q • y) := by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    have h := t.backward_forward x
    rw [hx, map_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  · intro y
    exact ⟨t.backward y, t.forward_backward y⟩

structure DoublingTower (A : ℕ → Type u) (B : ℕ → Type v)
    [∀ j, AddCommGroup (A j)] [∀ j, AddCommGroup (B j)] where
  comparison : ∀ j, A j →+ B j
  includeA : ∀ j, A j →+ A (j + 1)
  includeB : ∀ j, B j →+ B (j + 1)
  returnA : ∀ j, A (j + 1) →+ A j
  returnB : ∀ j, B (j + 1) →+ B j
  square : ∀ j x, comparison (j + 1) (includeA j x) =
    includeB j (comparison j x)
  natural : ∀ j x, returnB j (comparison (j + 1) x) =
    comparison j (returnA j x)
  doubleA : ∀ j x, includeA j (returnA j x) = 2 • x
  doubleB : ∀ j y, includeB j (returnB j y) = 2 • y
  base : BiTransfer (comparison 0) 1

variable {A : ℕ → Type u} {B : ℕ → Type v}
  [∀ j, AddCommGroup (A j)] [∀ j, AddCommGroup (B j)]

def transferAt (T : DoublingTower A B) :
    (j : ℕ) → BiTransfer (T.comparison j) (2 ^ j)
  | 0 => by simpa using T.base
  | j + 1 => by
    simpa [pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm] using
      doubleTransfer (T.comparison j) (T.comparison (j + 1))
        (T.includeA j) (T.includeB j) (T.returnA j) (T.returnB j)
        (T.square j) (T.natural j) (T.doubleA j) (T.doubleB j)
        (2 ^ j) (transferAt T j)

theorem tower_bounds (T : DoublingTower A B) (j : ℕ) :
    (∀ x, T.comparison j x = 0 → (2 ^ j) • x = 0) ∧
      (∀ y, ∃ x, T.comparison j x = (2 ^ j) • y) :=
  transfer_bounds (transferAt T j)

end GeneratedExcision

claims.natural_statement: Manuscript thm:main: for every n>=1 and prime p, every jointly continuous Z_p action on a connected Hausdorff second-countable topological n-manifold without boundary has nonzero kernel and factors through a finite quotient.

Manuscript prop:chart-reduction: a faithful continuous Z_p action on a connected manifold yields a faithful orientation-preserving action of an open subgroup on a connected invariant chart subset of R^n.

Manuscript thm:contradiction: an orientation-preserving continuous Z_p action on a connected open subset of R^n has nonzero kernel; the proof uses equal rational character parts of total 4u in a fixed denominator lattice.

Manuscript sections 5-6: the action-derived character classes are integral, covariant, homotopy invariant, have the stated sum and equal parts, and the moved test has nonzero degree. These inputs are not verified by the generated-excision mission.

Manuscript thm:sphere-lattice: for odd d>=3, E_d(S^d) rationally is the nonzero orientation line, and its integral image is contained in L_d^{-1} Z times that orientation for one fixed power of 2 independent of later action data.
Manuscript prop:sphere-rank: either sphere theory rationally splits as its point group plus the point group shifted by sphere dimension, in every degree.
Manuscript prop:generic-signature: finite semialgebraic Witt relations admit a common generic signature test, identifying the integral image on the degree-d rational orientation line with Z.

Section-2 category inputs: full ambient derived morphisms, compact bounds under finite constructions, actual summands, bounded canonical reflexive Verdier duality, and fully faithful compactly supported open extension hold on the actual generated categories.
Manuscript thm:homotopy and lat:point-groups give natural homotopy invariance for allowed possibly nonproper maps and point and S^0 comparison isomorphisms in every degree.
Manuscript thm:witt-localization gives natural integral long exact sequences in all degrees for the ordinary Verdier quotient by the compact-support open-extension kernel.

The manuscript dense-doubling construction defines a natural reverse homomorphism on Witt groups of a full replete dense duality-stable triangulated subcategory, with both composites equal to multiplication by 2.

For the actual T_0,T,P_0,P categories of Definition def:test-categories, the full assertions lem:cutoff, thm:germs, and prop:open-cover hold, including arbitrary ambient derived morphisms and actual summands.
